remarks: Tucked away on a quiet court and set on over a quarter-acre lot, this beautifully refreshed home is ready for its next chapter. Abundant natural light fills every room and highlights the home's brand-new finishes. New luxury vinyl plank flooring flows through the main living areas, complemented by plush new carpet, and fresh paint inside and out makes the home truly move-in ready. The floor plan offers four generous bedrooms plus a dedicated office (currently staged as bedroom, but does not have a closet), ideal for working from home.
